SELECT id, user_id, session_title, session_mode, model_mode, model_name, kb_id, is_pinned, status, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_session WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{sessionId}

mapper.select: SELECT cs.id, cs.user_id AS userId, cs.session_title AS sessionTitle, cs.session_mode AS sessionMode, cs.model_mode AS modelMode, cs.model_name AS modelName, cs.kb_id AS kbId, kb.kb_name AS kbName, cs.is_pinned AS isPinned, cs.status, cs.created_at AS createdAt, cs.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chat_session cs LEFT JOIN kb_knowledge_base kb ON kb.id = cs.kb_id WHERE cs.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET session_title = #{title}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE chat_session SET is_pinned = #{isPinned}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{sessionId}

UPDATE chat_session SET session_title = #{title}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND status = 1 AND (session_title IS NULL OR TRIM(session_title) = '' OR session_title = '新会话')
